listing.name: WipEout Omega Collection — wipeout_pc (AbdelmoumenDeghbouche)
listing.summary: Research project. Upstream early-development status claims boot/menus/saves and HD/2048 races/results, with 110–150FPS reported in2048 on RTX4070Laptop, not a full collection playthrough. New README reports extra render-resolution patches and experimental PS4 Pro mode GOW3_NEO=1 loading a race with correct picture sincev0.2.3; not tested further. All HD/HD Fury/2048 event types are not yet tested, HDR RCAS fix awaits testing and new audio effects may have defects; PSVR is not planned. Linux builds from source without a package; do not infer Linux gameplay/CPU qualification. No Portcove runtime or completion qualification was performed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own PS4 WipEout Omega Collection dump: README declares CUSA07671 US base01.00+update01.07 as development target and CUSA05670 EU with version unspecified. Merge owned base/update files or supply GOW3_PATCH_DIR; GoldHEN folder dumps are also documented. Runtime reads owned eboot.bin and game files and links own libc/Fios2/NpToolkit2. One executable serves 2048/HD/Fury; no separate implementation per component. Exact accepted executable/asset fingerprints remain Unknown.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Upstream README declares wipeout-windows.zip from Releases. Extract it, run WipEout.exe and select the owned game folder containing eboot.bin. Supply the matching owned base/update data as documented; runtime continues reading original files. Windows source build uses MSYS2 CLANG64/Python and upstream build.sh; Linux has a source-build route without a package or stated CPU matrix. No release asset was downloaded or verified. This manual discovery route is not managed acquisition or runtime qualification.
